From a nearby phone
A phone you connected to says it runs release %1$d (yours is %2$d). That is only its claim: nothing has been checked or downloaded.

1. On that phone, open Help and tap Share app nearby (or share the app any other way you like).
2. Receive the file on this phone.
3. Come back here, tap Choose the file, and pick it. MeshLive checks it before offering to install it.

Do not open the file from the browser or a file manager: they do not check it. If Android offers to Install a new app instead of Update this one, cancel. Nothing is installed without your confirmation.

Hide this note for a week

Update checks contact GitHub only (api.github.com, and github.com or its download servers for the file): GitHub sees your internet address and that you asked about MeshLive. Nothing else is sent, there is no account and no tracker. Files you receive from a nearby phone never touch the internet.
